falseSynonyms.zh: 清潔時間表不等於一次 cleaning session cleaning schedule 是列出何時清潔的時間表；session 是其中一次實際清潔時段。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A schedule organises cleaning sessions; it is not one of the sessions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 清潔服務不等於 cleaning session cleaning service 是整體服務／業務；session 是一次具體清潔活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A cleaning service may provide many cleaning sessions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 維修保養不等於清潔 maintenance 可包括維修、檢查、潤滑和更換零件；cleaning 只是其中一種工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cleaning may be part of maintenance, but maintenance is much broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 檢查不等於清潔 inspection 是查看和評估狀況；它可以在清潔前後進行，但本身不是清潔。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An inspection checks condition; a cleaning session removes dirt or restores cleanliness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 消毒不等於一般 cleaning disinfection 專門降低／消滅病原體；一般 cleaning 主要去除污垢和雜物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cleaning and disinfection are related but technically different processes.

falseSynonyms.zh: 房務／日常整理比 cleaning 更廣 housekeeping 可包括整理、補充用品、鋪床和管理房間；不是所有 housekeeping 都是 cleaning。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Housekeeping can include cleaning, but it also covers other routine room-care tasks.

falseSynonyms.zh: 家務雜務不等於 cleaning sessions chores 可包括洗衣、煮食、倒垃圾等多種工作；清潔只是其中一類。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cleaning can be a chore, but chores are a broader set of household tasks.

falseSynonyms.zh: 大掃除不等於一般 cleaning session spring cleaning 通常指偶爾進行的大規模徹底清潔；日常清潔時段通常不是。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Spring cleaning is an occasional major clean, not a general synonym for routine cleaning sessions.
